player_prompt.intro:
I ye Player {player_id} ye kɛlɛ Reverse Tic Tac Toe kɛlɛ la. I ka sɛmɛnti ye '{symbol}'.
Kɛlɛ kɔrɔ ye ka sɔrɔ kɛlɛ tɛnɛnɛ (kɔrɔnɛnɛ, sɔrɔnɛnɛ, walɛma sɔrɔnɛnɛ).
Ni i ye sɔrɔ kɛlɛ tɛnɛnɛ, i ye ɲɛ.
Sɔrɔ i ka kɛlɛ kɛ ka fɔrmɛ '[4]' ka sɛmɛnti i ka cell 4.
I ye Player {player_id}, i ye '{symbol}' ye i ka jagokun ye '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yɔrɔ min tɛ se ka yɛlɛma. I ye '[cell]' kɛ a la.
invalid_move.already_occupied: O yɔrɔ nin tɔɔ bɛɛ ye {cell}.

game_action.placed: Jokula {player_id} ka jiri ni ({symbol}) kɔnɔ kɛlɛ {cell}.

outcome.loss: Jurusalobaga {player_id} be bɔnɛ a ka juru sara!
outcome.draw: A laban, u ma se ka joo sɔrɔ.
